scope: Stage 1 teacher-parent initialization at the fixed 596M structure (configs/stages/stage-1/teacher_parent_initialization/design.json): one A_teacher_parent initialization from the teacher-parent selections and the teacher's statistics re-aggregated at the kept layers (session teacher_parent_init), then its two seeds trained with the A-MIX-6cat-sr recipe and each evaluated on all of eval-set-1 in both modes (session teacher_parent_train); B_packed_top1's sealed A-MIX evidence reused, never retrained. No search, no other arm, no Stage 4-6 work, no network volume.

teacher_parent_init.basis: setup (measured 10-20 min) + the teacher's load and three selection gates (~5 min) + the statistics replay (the journal's root width state: 172 s) + build, save, reload (~2 min) + state evaluation (~6 min) + relay copies of ~3.2 GB (~3 min)

teacher_parent_train.basis: A-MIX-6cat-sr measured on the same card, model shape, pack and recipe (a_train_sr_mix_20261109_193709): 32,322 / 32,394 s training per seed (median 3.21 s per optimizer step, 9,701 steps), evaluation 3,992 / 4,005 s thinking and 1,153 / 1,390 s non-thinking, 20.9 h driver, 21.3 h and $23.4143 all-in at $1.09/h; plus ~2% for the save-point copies to the relay and ~6 min for the two final copies. The training deadline per seed is the measured time + 11%; the evaluation time is A's own and may differ from B's (bounded by the 8,192-token context)

position_at_proposal.balance_note: the maintainer reported a top-up to about $60 on 2026-11-17; read again at issue and launch (the issuer and the launcher refuse a cap plus reserve the balance does not cover)

granted_by: nobody: a proposal, not a grant

money_rules.own_envelope: the ceiling counts only this study's runs (study_engineering.spent filters by plan id). RI-S1, RI-LM1 and Research A are CLOSED; their unspent allowances lapsed and fund nothing here; a provider top-up is not a grant
money_rules.ceiling: $31.50 is what sessions may draw, cumulatively over every attempt and both kinds (each session's closeout all-in; an unknown cost refuses)
money_rules.teardown_reserve: $1.00 held outside the ceiling and never issued: each artifact's hard cap plus the reserve must fit what the project cap and the provider balance leave, at issue and again at launch (layer_merge_launch.reserve_problems)
money_rules.study_cumulative_cap: ceiling + reserve = $32.50, inside the $32.67 the $1,000 project cap leaves; the project cap is not raised
money_rules.per_session_hard_cap: init $2.00, train $28.00: the all-in bound from the create to the hard deadline plus the watchdog's teardown at the accepted price; the deadline is derived from the price
money_rules.recovery: expected $25.20 leaves ~$6.30 under the ceiling: one resumed training attempt (setup, the restore of the latest save point from the relay -- at most one hour of steps lost -- and the remaining work) fits; a session that runs to its full cap does not leave room for another, and the study then ends BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with every finished unit kept
money_rules.budget_terminal_state: BUDGET_EXHAUSTED when what the ceiling leaves is below min_useful_attempt_usd ($1.50: an init attempt; a resumed training attempt needs at least ~$3 -- setup, the save-point restore and one hour of steps -- and its cap is set from the remaining work) or the next cap plus the reserve does not fit the project cap or the balance: the issuer refuses, every finished unit is kept, every other one is reported not_run

hardware: one NVIDIA L40S (48 GB) per session, secure cloud, at most $1.11/h; A-MIX peaked at 17.5 GB allocated in training, the packed search at 36.2 GB: no A100 (no measured L40S out-of-memory)
storage: no network volume. The relay holds the round's weights while it runs (the init 1.2 GB, statistics 1.9 GB, at most two save points of ~5.9 GB per unit at once, two finals of 2.4 GB); probed 2026-11-17: a 37 GiB object would be accepted. The dev box keeps the init, its statistics and both finals at the terminal state (~7.1 GB; 5.5 GB free on 2026-11-17: see the retention plan in the report)
authorizes: nothing: a proposal; the grant is the maintainer's (launch.py grant --decision '<quoted>' --granted-by maintainer)
